tasks.label: Probe NVIDIA embed models
tasks.command: node -e "const { OpenAI } = require('openai'); const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.NVIDIA_API_KEY, baseURL: 'https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1' }); const models = ['nvidia/nv-embed-v1','nvidia/nv-embedqa-e5-v5']; (async () => { for (const model of models) { try { const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model, input: ['hello world'] }); console.log('MODEL', model, 'OK', res.data[0].embedding.length); } catch (e) { console.log('MODEL', model, 'ERR', e.status, e.message); } } })();"
